1.english_reference: And the LORD spake unto Moses , saying ,

traditions.VUL: Locutúsque est Dóminus ad Móysen , dicens :
traditions.SP: ו ידבר יהוה אל משׁה ל אמר
traditions.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses , saying ,

2.english_reference: Speak unto the children of Israel , saying ,

traditions.WLC: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵ אמֹ֔ר

traditions.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel , saying ,

2.english_reference: If a woman have conceived seed , and born a man child :

traditions.SP: אשׁה כי תזרע ו ילדה זכר
traditions.KJV: If a woman have conceived seed , and born a man child :

2.english_reference: then she shall be unclean seven days ;

traditions.WLC: וְ טָֽמְאָה֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים

traditions.SP: ו טמאה שׁבעת ימים
traditions.KJV: then she shall be unclean seven days ;

2.english_reference: according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean .

traditions.WLC: כִּ ימֵ֛י נִדַּ֥ת דְּוֺתָ֖ הּ תִּטְמָֽא

traditions.WLC: וּ בַ יּ֖וֹם הַ שְּׁמִינִ֑י יִמּ֖וֹל בְּשַׂ֥ר עָרְלָתֽ וֹ

traditions.SP: ו ב יום ה שׁמיני ימול את בשׂר ערלתו
traditions.KJV: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised .

4.english_reference: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days ;

traditions.WLC: וּ שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים יוֹם֙ וּ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֔ים תֵּשֵׁ֖ב בִּ דְמֵ֣י טָהֳרָ֑ה

4.english_reference: she shall touch no hallowed thing ,

traditions.SP: עד מלאת ימי טהרה
traditions.KJV: until the days of her purifying be fulfilled .

5.english_reference: and she shall continue in the blood of her purifying threescore and six days .

traditions.SP: ו ב מלאת ימי טהרה
traditions.KJV: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled ,
